name: this was for you.
source:
After you died, I wasn't sure what to do with myself. The world lost its color, nothing seemed right. Even now, I haven’t found a way forward.

My heart is empty, my feelings left long ago.

Your memory is all that's left…

[From [url=https://watercress.itch.io/this-was-for-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你死后，我不知道自己该怎么办。世界失去了色彩，一切都变得不对劲。直到现在，我还没有找到前进的方向。

我的心空了，我的感情早已离开。

你的记忆就只剩下这些了……

[来自[url=https://watercress.itch.io/this-was-for-you]itch.io[/url]]
